title: Cloud & DevOps
description: Cloud architecture, migration, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and operations from Techlio on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
h1: Releases that are routine, on infrastructure you can reason about.
intro: We design, migrate and run cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. Deployments become a button, environments are defined in code, and you can see cost and reliability at a glance.
caption: A developer push triggers the CI pipeline and infrastructure as code, deploys to staging and production, and feeds autoscaling, observability and cost reporting.

card.lead: Deploy on a Tuesday afternoon without holding your breath.
card.text: Cloud architecture, migration, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code, with monitoring and cost reporting your team can read.

offerIntro: Four stages, in order. You can stop after any of them and keep what was built.

offerings.title: Cloud strategy and architecture
offerings.text: A review of what you run today and a target design covering networking, environments, data, security boundaries and cost.

offerings.title: Migration
offerings.text: Workloads moved in stages with rollback at each step, containerized where it helps, with data migrations rehearsed before the real cutover.

offerings.title: CI/CD and infrastructure as code
offerings.text: Automated build, test and deploy pipelines, with every environment defined in version control so it can be recreated on demand.

offerings.title: Operate and optimize
offerings.text: Dashboards, alerts and runbooks for the team on call, plus regular cost and reliability reviews with concrete actions.

why.title: Deploys stop being events
why.text: Small, automated releases with canaries and rollback replace the long, tense deployment evening.

why.title: Nothing lives in one person’s head
why.text: Infrastructure is code, reviewed and versioned. A new engineer can read how production is built.

why.title: Cost you can explain
why.text: Spend is tagged by service and environment and reviewed on a schedule, so the bill has no surprises.

closeTitle: Is your infrastructure slowing your releases?
closeText: Describe your current setup and what hurts. We will reply within 24 hours with where we would start.
